blocks.text: The Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal is used by Zscaler partners so that they can manage their provisioned customers and tenants. These provisioned customers and tenants can use different Zscaler clouds based on their access.

A Zscaler partner can have multiple customers, and each customer might have multiple tenant organizations linked under them. Through the Multi-Tenant Portal, a partner can view this hierarchy from their partner account. The Multi-Tenant Portal provides a single interface for partners to get a complete view of their customers and tenants.
To learn more, see Accessing and Navigating the Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal.
Zscaler partners are given insights into all of their customer and tenant accounts from the Multi-Tenant Portal, which also offers:

blocks.item: A single interface that allows you to oversee customers across different Zscaler clouds.
In-depth visibility over the customer and tenant account configurations and policies.
Ability to white label the admin portals that your tenants access.
Swift configuration process by predefining policy templates to apply them on to your customers.
SSO (Single Sign-On) access to the admin portals that your tenants access.
